text: Conditions which require immediate corrective action by the flight crew are indicated by red warning lights located in the area of the pilot's primary field of vision. Conditions which require timely corrective action by the flight crew are indicated by amber caution lights. Blue lights do not require immediate crew attention. Which lights require timely corrective action by the flight crew?
